note: OWNED-FLEET basis, and the basis must be stated wherever this is used. IndiGo FY2026 block hours were 1,220,966 domestic plus 398,604 international = 1,619,570 total, over 441 aircraft at period end, giving 1,619,570 / 441 / 365 = 10.06 hours per aircraft per day. This is the second such both-ends check in the repo after DGCA vs Eurostat. The widely quoted ~13 hours/day is NOT in conflict: it is an ACTIVE-fleet number. 1,619,570 / 365 / 13 implies about 341 active aircraft, so roughly 100 of the 441 owned were grounded, consistent with the Pratt & Whitney engine AOG. Use this owned-fleet floor for the capacity leg and see aircraft_utilisation_hours_per_day_active for the ceiling.
